notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Additions:

Implemented multiple save slots, allowing players to save and load different progress files.

Introduced a free-fly camera that activates upon hero death in campaign mode.


Fixes & Improvements:

Resolved an issue where tooltips would remain stuck when upgrading a hero.

Fixed a bug where the Undead Draugr failed to deal damage during certain animations.

Corrected an animation bug with Goblin units.

Addressed an issue where units could spawn on top of the bridge in the Swamp scene.

Added language translations for all abilities (full translations for the rest of the game are coming soon).

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 3
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

📈 Added Level 60 cap.

⚔️ Fixed Knight’s Slash ability collider so it now hits correctly.

🏰 Fixed bug where enemies could spawn on walls, they now no longer do that.

🎮 You can now start a New Game in Campaign directly from the Play Menu.

👻 Added a cooldown to Wraith Form ability.

⚡ Improved performance in Sandbox mode.

🏆 Fixed campaign victory prompt the “Press TAB to return to editor” message no longer shows up after winning. Only shows in Sandbox.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

🏰 Fixed Orcs spawning on top of castle walls — they now spawn correctly on the ground.

⚔️ Fixed dungeon death bug where characters could fall through the ground after dying.

🏹 You can now cancel aiming when firing projectiles by using Right-Click, Dodge, or Roll.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hotfix Patch Notes

🛠️ Fixed Orc hero buffs not applying correctly.

🛡️ Fixed Paladin’s health upgrade to now work as intended.

☠️ Fixed Necromancer’s Raise Dead ability no longer kills summons.

notes.title: ALPHA Playtest and Wargames Fest is now over!
notes.content:
Short but sweet, with over 500 playtesters signing up over the course of 3 days was a great success! We've learned a lot about the good things and  bad things about the game and to make the best of our time we decided to end the test prematurely to focus on developing and improving the game! 

Watch out for the next playtest and if you feel you want to be a dedicated playtester with access to the full game, let us know on Discord!

A big thanks to our community, 

The Warborne Studios Crew

notes.title: ALPHA Playtest is now LIVE!
notes.content:
We have selected a limited batch of users to access the game, but do not fret, we will give access to more people very soon!

A small portion of the game is available in this ALPHA playtest as we work towards releasing a solid Demo in the future.

Expect issues, glitches, and crashes as we work towards a more refined version of the game. We are also looking for feedback on the gameplay, ideas, and anything you can think of that would improve the game.

Have fun, and we look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

Warborne Studios

notes.title: Wargames Fest 2025
notes.content:
We are joining WARGAMES FEST 2025!

Sign up for our limited Playtest, and we will announce when spots are available and the playtest is active.
Get ready to hack'n'slash your way through a tiny part of the Campaign and Sandbox mode. Please help us find bugs and develop the direction for the game!

Wishlisting helps us out a lot, so please go ahead and click the button! We are looking forward to seeing you on the battlefield!
